record.question: Under Rule 3-C of CCS (Conduct) Rules, which of the following is the most accurate statement of the main prohibition?
options: No Government servant shall indulge in sexual harassment of a woman employee within the office premises.
No Government servant shall indulge in sexual harassment of any woman during official duty hours.
No Government servant shall indulge in any act of sexual harassment of any woman at any workplace.
No Government servant shall indulge in sexual harassment of any woman subordinate to him at a Government workplace.
